sample_unit: pregnant and postpartum women rating the deployed system

links.outcome: Whether interface let users see the source of generated guidance
links.effect: Interface showed that retrieval occurred but not whether guidance came from a clinically reviewed source; process transparency and source attribution are not interchangeable.
links.quote: Interviews indicated that the interface showed users that retrieval had occurred but not whether guidance came from aclinically reviewed source, suggesting that process transparency and source attribution are not interchangeable.

unlisted_practices: Screening candidate model configurations against physician-authored reference answers before deployment

screen.reason: Evaluates a newly developed Bangla-language retrieval-augmented conversational agent deployed formatively with pregnant and postpartum women, without comparing outcomes under a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
